messages.subject: [Ann] Maintenance update StatET 3.3.2 testing
messages.body_plain:
Dear StatET users,

the testing version of the maintenance update StatET 3.3.2 is available 
for download. The update should fix most reported bugs, e.g.
  - R snippets wasn't executed via menu in new Eclipse versions
  - Elements in the outline of the R editor was missing if name occurs
    several times
  - Parsing of \ensuremath in LaTeX/Sweave files sometimes caused an
    error

The update is available for Eclipse 3.8, 4.2 and 4.3 via online-update from:
http://download.walware.de/eclipse-3.8/testing
http://download.walware.de/eclipse-4.2/testing
http://download.walware.de/eclipse-4.3/testing

As usual it is also available as file archive from the download page:
http://www.walware.de/?page=/it/downloads/statet.html

Please let us know if you encounter problems with the new version.

Regards,
Stephan


-- 
http://www.walware.de/goto/statet
